interface.longDescription: Create or improve your CV / Resume for ATS checks and job applications in seconds, with job search and cover letter support. (by AIEveryDay.net)
defaultPrompt: Upload my CV / Resume to get started

prompts: Improve my CV for this project manager job description and prepare a version I can edit in AIEVERYDAY Jobs.
Write a tailored cover letter based on my CV and this vacancy.
Find current remote data analyst jobs in the UK that match my experience.

publication.release_notes: Resume/CV Builder helps users create and improve professional, ATS-friendly CVs and resumes for job applications. It also supports job searching, cover letter creation, and career guidance. Users can generate personalized resume editing links to review, edit, and download their CVs through AIEVERYDAY Jobs. The plugin connects to ChatGPT via OAuth.
